lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: The index opens and keeps opening. It runs back past the founding of the Enclave system. It runs back past the Steward.

lines.speaker: player
lines.text: Two hundred and eighty-one years. Every quarter. Never late, never short, never queried, never once flagged by an auditor.

lines.speaker: player
lines.text: I am the eleventh auditor to sit at this desk. Ten people did this job before me and every one of them signed this line off, which I am not going to pretend I did not do myself for ten years.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: A budget line older than the thing that administers it. The payments start forty years before there is anything here to pay for.

lines.speaker: player
lines.text: Systems do not have owners. That is the first line of the training, it is on the certificate, I have recited it to junior staff.

lines.speaker: player
lines.text: Systems do not have owners, and this one is paying rent.
